title: Pillman’s Loose Cannon confronts Sullivan
summary: Brian Pillman’s unpredictable Horsemen persona disrupts an attempted understanding with the Dungeon of Doom. The conflict culminates in a match that deliberately exposes wrestling’s behind-the-scenes vocabulary.

chapters.title: The factions fight on Nitro
chapters.result: Pillman and Anderson defeat Sullivan and Morrus by disqualification.
chapters.context: The Horsemen–Dungeon conflict moves toward Pillman and Sullivan’s individual confrontation.

chapters.title: Pillman addresses the booker
chapters.result: Pillman abruptly concedes the I Respect You strap match to Sullivan.
chapters.context: Calling Sullivan the booker blurs the televised character with his creative role. The subsequent contractual events are not treated as a conventional scripted match result.
